test_title: PYST 26: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: During the third leg of Navika Sagar Parikrama II, which significant milestone did INSV Tarini achieve in January 2025?

options.text: Docked at Port Stanley for the first time
Completed a full circumnavigation of Antarctica
Crossed Point Nemo, the Oceanic Pole of Inaccessibility

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Crossed Point Nemo, the Oceanic Pole of Inaccessibility**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Point Nemo**, also known as the **Oceanic Pole of Inaccessibility**, is the location in the ocean that is farthest from any land.
 
• It is situated in the **South Pacific Ocean**, approximately 2,688 kilometers from the nearest land.
